title: alchemilla alpina var. pallens
intro: Alchemilla alpina var. pallens, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and soothe skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla alpina var. pallens include wound healing, anti-edematous, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in the treatment of minor wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
